description:
Find PropertyList agencies (estate agents) in a given area, ranked by
how many active listings they carry there. Returns up to 10 agencies
with name, location, listing count, and `url`: the agency's page on
PropertyList, listing its properties, in the language asked for.
`url` is null for the few agencies PropertyList shows no page for.
Use this after a buyer has narrowed in on an area and wants to know
which agencies dominate it.

language.description: Language of the agency pages linked in url.

location.description: Place name (city, suburb, or urbanisation). e.g. 'Estepona'.

name: list_agencies

listing_count.description: Active listings it carries in the area.

url.description: The agency's page on PropertyList, in the language asked for; null when PropertyList shows no page for it.

title: List agencies
